_doc: Parameters for rimflow_v3_sim.py (item RIMFLOW_SIM_BUILD_FACTORY_IN_A_BOTTLE). Every number says what it is: CALIBRATED (measured on disk, source given), CONFIG (read from dispatcher_schedule.json or the v3 design), DERIVED (computed from calibrated numbers by a stated rule), or ASSUMED (no measurement; a prior range that is swept, never fitted to a single value). Calibration window: ledger 7 d to 2026-10-27T06:25Z (rimflow_metrics.py --days 7 --json), spend census 7 d (D:\ClaudeWork\rimmandrake\perpetual_ctx\spend_census.json), owner messages 10-05..10-27 (D:\ClaudeWork\rimmandrake\orch_record\friction\owner_classified.jsonl).

helper_ite_q.source: spend_census.json subagents, family BENCH+FOUNDRY role subagent, 1,271 helpers, 41 quantiles (pooled by seat below)
helper_ite_q._note: top quantile clipped from 42.4M/25.3M to 12M (single outliers; the clip lowers mean ITE by ~2%)

helper_dur_q.source: same helpers, wall seconds; ITE and duration are sampled with ONE shared uniform (measured Spearman 0.89 BENCH, 0.88 FOUNDRY)

seat_ite_per_close.source: top-level ITE BENCH 126.0M + FOUNDRY 45.0M per 7 d / 928 closes

background_ite_week.source: spend census: every family other than BENCH/FOUNDRY (art-eval headless 107M, other headless, Hestia) per 7 d; charged flat

owner_present_p_by_hour.source: share of the 23 days with >=1 typed owner message in that local (PDT) hour; 1,638 messages; 11.8 present h/day. CAUTION (GPT r2 #7): message timestamps are endogenous, more breakdowns -> more presence; swept by owner_presence_mult

foundry_share.source: FOUNDRY 2,337 of 5,572 BENCH+FOUNDRY ledger events, 7 d (proxy for the share of work it takes)

account_used_at_128h.source: account_usage series.jsonl 2026-10-26 (lukas, steven ESTIMATE; system MEASURED)

account_quota.source: Q_a = sim ITE routed to account a by hour 128 of the member's own v2 calibration week / account_used_at_128h[a]. Consequence: token results are RELATIVE to today's burn, never absolute

week_reset.value: Wed 13:00 local; the sim week starts at a reset

role_costs.source: Operations caps from the schedule (60k/run, 150k economy, 2 runs/day) are CONFIG ceilings used as costs; all other role costs ASSUMED (see priors *_ite)

n_rig.source: two test machines (Steve, archmagi) share the Arbiter's check slots

lam_ext_h.why: owner-origin tickets filed per present hour

p_prod_ext.why: share of owner-origin tickets that are product work

f_prod.why: follow-up tickets filed per finished product ticket

f_proc.why: follow-up tickets per finished process ticket (process breeds process; branching factor, GPT r2 #6)

p_proc_child.why: share of follow-ups that are process tickets

p_park.why: filed tickets parked (proposed, never worked in the horizon); WIP shows 798 proposed

p_quick.why: worked tickets closed by the seat itself with no helper (697/928 closes never started)

dispatch_min.why: seat minutes to brief and launch one helper

helpers_per_job.why: mean helpers launched per helper-backed ticket (182 helpers/day vs 133 closes/day, most closes quick)

init_queue.why: ready tickets per seat at the start of the warm-up week (today's 'ready'+'doing' WIP is mostly stale; never start empty)

helper_cap_v2.why: concurrent helpers per seat today (CLAUDE.md asks for <=N; actual UNMEASURED, D4)

kappa.why: extra defect rate per additional concurrent helper (coordination cost)

b_shared.why: share of defects invisible to every check (shared blind spot, GPT r1/r2)

s_self.why: maker self-check sensitivity (0 findings in 2,744 self-reviews is an observation, not a sensitivity)

s_rig.why: v2 verify-run sensitivity to a visible defect

p_fix.why: a repair removes a detected defect

e_disc.why: per latent defect discovery hazard, per day (exposure)

p_link.why: a discovered defect is filed with caused_by an already-done item (the rework observable)

p_stall.why: seat ends its turn and waits when nothing is in flight

r_self_h.why: stalled seat resumes on its own (task notification, scheduled wake), per hour

notice_min.why: owner's mean delay before he notices a stalled window, when present

p_watch.why: owner watches a given window while present

lam_status_h.why: status/'how is it going' pings per present hour

p_owner_card.why: filed tickets that need an owner decision (~110 owner-wait items in 7 d / 1,550 filed)

c_wake_ite.why: ITE of one woken turn (cache-cold reload)

p_ring_ok.why: a Dispatcher ring is consumed and the window resumes

p_unwork.why: a woken window finds its next ticket unworkable (needs owner/bridge) and stops again

acct_w_lukas.why: share of burn routed to the lukas account (system and steven split the rest)

arb_fr_max.why: Arbiter false-reject probability at strictness 1 (scales with strictness^2)

arb_batch_q.why: Arbiter queue length above which it batches

arb_batch_gamma.why: sensitivity multiplier while batching (the rubber-stamp mechanism)

teeth.why: a new role's effectiveness multiplier in its first week

s_aud.why: Auditor sensitivity to a visible latent defect

p_rule.why: an audit finding becomes an enforced rule

rule_delta.why: fractional cut in mu_prod per enforced rule (0 = learning does nothing)

rule_check_min.why: rig minutes each rule adds to every Arbiter check (check-suite ratchet)

m_ops_waste.why: Operations' effect on helper ITE (economy pass)

m_innov.why: Innovator's weekly effect on mu_prod (scenario; >1 = harm)

m_cond.why: Conductor quick mode's effect on status pings

cond_ite_msg.why: Conductor ITE per owner message (fresh context + metrics pack)

role_build_tix.why: process tickets filed to build/tune a role when it is switched on

role_cards_day.why: owner cards per day per new role during its first week

q_card.note: per present hour, chance the owner answers any one waiting card (a card he defers stays queued); replaces a fixed card service rate, which gave either ~0 or unbounded waits

nudges_d.source: friction census: 40% of ~78 typed msgs/day machine-driving

helpers_week.source: spend census: BENCH 624 + FOUNDRY 647 helper transcripts

v2._doc: today: two windows, owner un-sticks them
